name.baseName: Window frame, wood-metal, w/o surface treatment, m2 visible, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The measures of the window are 1.75m (width) x 1.3m (height). The average visible area is 0.29m2. The bill of materials is based on data from 4 window producers.; UUID: 20fe14d8-fbf8-3e3a-a98b-46fcb786e35e

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Industry data.

# Included processes
Included are the materials used in a wooden-metal window frame (without surface treatment and metal panelling). Production losses, work materials, packaging materials, energy demand and the transport of the materials are also included.

referenceToDataSource.common:shortDescription: 2020 - LCA wooden windows and doors - Ramseier

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data survey at 4 window manufacturers in Switzerland.
